hunt.justification: CVE-2026-123007 is a critical unauthenticated RCE on a primary edge component. Identifying and validating the required 128GB traffic flood provides high confidence in the presence or absence of this specific exploitation attempt.

meta.name: NGINX HTTP/2 Integer Underflow and RCE

related.reason: Monitoring for post-exploitation egress from NGINX containers is a sibling hunt that detects the aftermath regardless of the exploit used.

meta.analysis: A standard rule for 120GB connections would cause excessive noise in high-traffic environments. This hunt correlates that extreme volume specifically with NGINX worker activity and version inventory, providing a context-aware pivot that a single rule cannot perform.

stages.name: High-Volume HTTP/2 Flow-Control Exploit
observables: Approximately 128 GB of HTTP/2 data transmitted
Persistent connection duration between 2.5 and 17 minutes
HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames with SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE changes

stages.name: NGINX Worker Remote Code Execution
observables: Out-of-bounds reads/writes in worker process context
Anomalous child processes (e.g., shell or network utilities) spawned by nginx worker

scenario.summary: An unauthenticated remote attacker exploits a critical integer underflow in NGINX's HTTP/2 implementation (CVE-2026-123007) by transmitting approximately 128 GB of data over a sustained connection. Successful exploitation triggers memory corruption in the NGINX worker process, leading to remote code execution during response processing.

meta.rationale: Focus on Internet-facing NGINX servers or ingress controllers. Start with edge nodes serving HTTPS/2 traffic.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is exploiting a critical integer underflow in NGINX's HTTP/2 flow control by transmitting a high-volume data flood to corrupt memory and execute code within the NGINX worker process context.

min_bytes_flood.description: Traffic volume threshold in bytes (approx 120GB) required to trigger the counter underflow.

hunt.name: NGINX HTTP/2 Integer Underflow and RCE
hunt.description: Exploitation requires approximately 128 GB of data to be transmitted to trigger the underflow, which then allows for an out-of-bounds memory copy. The adversary floods the target server with HTTP/2 traffic to corrupt the worker process's memory. This hunt identifies vulnerable NGINX versions and then searches for the characteristic 120GB+ inbound traffic flood and suspicious child processes spawned by NGINX workers. The analyst reviews the correlated evidence to confirm remote code execution.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%nginx%' AND (instr(',' || '{{vulnerable_versions}}' || ',', ',' || package_version || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify hosts running versions of NGINX known to be vulnerable to the HTTP/2 integer underflow.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts and their NGINX versions. None means no known vulnerable software is present.

primitive_config.label: Scope vulnerable NGINX versions
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%nginx%' AND (instr(',' || '{{vulnerable_versions}}' || ',', ',' || package_version || ',') > 0)
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts and their NGINX versions. None means no known vulnerable software is present.

config.objective: Confirm which hosts from the inventory results are running vulnerable versions of NGINX as specified in the report.
config.description: The agent reviews the inventory result to confirm if any host is within the target scope for exploitation.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts confirmed as vulnerable and requiring deeper inspection.
config.success_criteria: A list of hosts with confirmed vulnerable NGINX versions.

config.question: the evaluate-scope-lead verdict is that at least one host is running a vulnerable NGINX version
config.condition: the evaluate-scope-lead verdict is that at least one host is running a vulnerable NGINX version
config.description: Avoid expensive traffic and process queries if no vulnerable NGINX hosts are present in the estate.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_received_bytes, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (dst_endpoint_port IN (443, 8443)) AND direction = 'inbound' AND state_kind = 'log' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip HAVING total_received_bytes > {{min_bytes_flood}}
config.description: Identify external source IPs that have transmitted the extreme volumes of data received by the NGINX server to trigger the integer underflow.
config.expected_signal: One or more source IPs sending over 120GB to a single host. A unique IP hitting one host is highly suspicious.

primitive_config.label: Detect 120GB+ inbound HTTP/2 data floods
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_received_bytes, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (dst_endpoint_port IN (443, 8443)) AND direction = 'inbound' AND state_kind = 'log' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip HAVING total_received_bytes > {{min_bytes_flood}}
primitive_config.expected: One or more source IPs sending over 120GB to a single host. A unique IP hitting one host is highly suspicious.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%nginx%') AND (LOWER(process_name) IN ('sh', 'bash', 'nc', 'curl', 'wget', 'python', 'perl', 'socat', 'cp', 'mv', 'chmod') OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%/dev/tcp/%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find shells, network utilities, or staging tools spawned by NGINX processes, indicating successful code execution.
config.expected_signal: A shell, downloader, or utility process whose parent is an NGINX worker. Silence indicates no obvious RCE took place during the window.

primitive_config.expected: A shell, downloader, or utility process whose parent is an NGINX worker. Silence indicates no obvious RCE took place during the window.
